This had better not be a waste of time.

W-w-wait a moment! That's Elesa! The Elesa!
Okay, fine. The name is Carmine. Don't come crying to me when I beat you!
My name is Carmine. Try and remember it even after I beat you senseless.
The name is Carmine. My game? Grinding you into dust.
Oh, I'm going to stick with these for sure.
Ha! Keep your cards!
No need to push my luck...
Eh. ~Cards.text~ ~cards.ifplural(cards|card)~.
Just give me ~cards.text~.
Let's go with ~cards.text~ for me.

I hope you're ready to eat dirt.

Don't waste our time. Your cards aren't going to magically get better by just staring at them!
Hardly seems fair for me to be this good and have luck on my side.
I hope you're keeping on your toes. I do expect a bit of a struggle, after all.
This one is gonna sting.
Don't forget to savor the bitter taste of defeat.
The way I see it, you're either about to lose or about to lose bad.
No. It is not difficult being this good at everything.
This time you're going to get it!
Show's over, chump. You won't get me so easily!
You've had your fun, but now is the part where I kick you until you stay down.
Don't wimp out on me now! Let's see just how badly I beat you!
That's the stuff. Now I can shove your face in the dirt.
Now I'm ready for a clean sweep!
Obviously seeing me like this is too motivating for you. I should have figured.
I know you want to see more, but don't think for a second I'm about to make it easy for you.
You don't get to my level from just choking under pressure!
This should put me back in control no matter how determined I've made you.
I could do with some matcha mochi right about now...
Like I need to go all out to win at this dumb game...
Don't overthink it. After all, there's no way it's gonna help.
Could you maybe hurry it up?
Sucks you aren't going to see more of me this time.
I can admire trying to put your best foot forward, but don't think I'm going to take any pity on you.
Hopefully you can control yourself around me.
I know you're motivated, so you might just stand a chance. A slim chance, but a chance.
If you have to think about your choices so hard, you're probably sunk anyway.
Ugh. I'm trying to win here, but I know you're probably trying hard for a different reason. I guess I get it...
Could be fun to see a little more of you. Winning does have its perks.
Just because it's a friendly competition doesn't mean I'm going to be a friendly competitor. Got it?
C'mon! Choke! Choke! Choke! Choke!
This is cutting it way closer than I want...
No, no. I shouldn't worry. There's no way I could get beat...
Ugh. You should be eating so much dirt right now...
You can't lose. Just think happy thoughts, Carmine. Matcha. Mochi. Chips. The tears of your defeated enemies. Picnics.
What the heck? I need a guarantee! Not whatever this is!
Obviously I gave you a little too much motivation...
Hmph. If it's the best I can do, then I bet it's the best anyone could do.
What was wrong with just admiring me while I still had all my clothes? Seems like a good deal to me...
D-don't try so hard to win, okay? I-it's not, like, flattering or anything...
Excuse me?! What's this junk supposed to be?!
Mrrgh. Don't get a big head, okay? No matter what happens...
No. No. No. No! No! No!
Ah... uh... oh boy...
Why would you do this to meeee?!
Oh, you can get right out of here with that noise!
No one is going to be motivated to try if I don't put up a good fight...
What?! Of all the rotten--- rrrgh!
Screwing up is so embarrassing...
Hey! What gives?! This isn't how things are supposed to work!
Hnng... it's not fair for this to be happening now...
Don't think I'm going to stand for this injustice! Mark my words!
Mmmph... I liked it better when I hadn't lost so much...
This isn't over! It can't be over! Not yet!
This is going to be a nightmare if I talked such a big game only to lose completely...
I-I'm not making it easy. D-don't think you deserve that!
It's just bad luck! Nothing but bad luck! Don't go getting any other funny ideas!
Now it hardly matters if you're motivated or not...
I'll make this crap work if I have to! You'll see!
How is anyone going to see how great I am if I can't hold it together at this point?
Wow! Really? Pfft! Nice tits, I guess. You don't seem so tough now!
Seriously? How'd you mess that up? Were you sick when magic school was teaching people not to flash people?
Serves you right! Using magic and then getting all uppity about it! Enjoy that draft!
That sort of black lacy stuff is... it's not bad, though. That's... whatever, you know?
Making yourself some sexy underwear means you're enjoying the attention on some level, right?
I mean... seriously. If you were embarrassed you could have made, like, shorts and not... lingerie.
Mari... if you don't like school, why not just, like, leave? It's not like you can't go back later if you want. Save it for when you can be serious about it.
Are you really sticking with those shades? I don't think they're helping you as much as you were hoping.
... Almost forgot he's still wearing those... dumb shades.
... If that thing on his shoulder is a Pokémon, I've never seen it before...
The part of me I'd never want to lose? Speaking as a complete package, I try not to play favorites with all my good parts...
Dreams, hm? I had this weird dream that the Lousy Three were all under my control and we thrashed everyone who opposed us. Wonder if that dream had anything to do with that incident...
Uh... nightmares? Well, I had this one freaky one where Kiki and Terapagos... well... where we weren't able to stop them...
Okay, that's seriously crazy! You're almost too cool to be bumming around here.
Yeah, Mari, I might not be fully qualified to weigh in...
Hey, look who you're talking to, Mari. I think a guy would be over the moon to take care of himself just while I'm nearby.
Pampering, huh? I guess I could live with someone else feeding me the chips when I do my nightly face mask.
Well, Senko, I certainly don't want to go back to life before my Rotom Phone! Now I can get all the cute pics of myself that I want!
Hey! Kiki is strictly off limits to everyone!
Do NOT go looking for more information about... that little purple menace.
They were stealing and hurting people! What else would you call that?!
You seem put together enough, Yuzuki. I'm sure whatever it is can't be all that bad.
Wh-what's all this about a curse? The vibe is... getting a little weird...
Of course it was, Leon. What? You think you're the first person to go that route?
Well, you could have fooled me!
Well... if you want a taste that badly...
I think you're aiming for something a little more than just a repeat of today, hm?
You're a lot less skeleton-y than someone claiming to be... whatever it is you're claiming to be. I don't really get it...
Wiz, are you sure you're, like, dead? I always imagined the undead a lot paler and... not quite so busty.
My adventures? Well, I only saved Kitakami from the Loyal Three, is all. Had a little help from my brother and a friend, but I basically took them all down single-handedly.
You want to hear about adventures, Wiz? Well, I could tell you all about meeting Ogerpon and getting her masks back. It was pretty crazy.
Adventures, huh? Well, after everything I went through the craziest thing to happen was still meeting Terapagos in Area Zero. Ugh... well, at least Kiki is doing better now...
A-adventures, Wiz? That's... w-well... some stories don't need to be recounted. E-even if I was tricked into eating that stuff, I wasn't the only one! I-It's not worth getting into!
Where are we? This place is called "The Inventory," right? Seems like a bunch of different places all smashed together. I sorta gave up on trying to figure out anything beyond that...

Cooking is... whatever. I can do it, but it's a hassle. Snacks are tasty and easy. Still, picnics are all the rage right now, so I've been making a lot of sandwiches for me and my Pokémon to enjoy on sunny days.
Cooking, huh? I wouldn't call myself a cooking buff, but it is kinda fun to make mochi when festival time rolls around. It's even more fun to eat the mochi, though.
Camp cooking, huh? Closest I've come is packing a picnic lunch to enjoy while I'm out. I hear in Galar they like to cook entire curry pots when they're out in the field. That seems extra, doesn't it?
You want a story, Nadeshiko? Because I can literally tell you about how I saved Kitakami and righted a centuries old wrong. It's riveting stuff.
Oh, I've got tales that could blow the socks off of anything else anyone here could talk about, Nadeshiko. I'm talking epic battles, tragic backstories, and of course a beautiful and cunning heroine.
Huh? What's that? A story about me? What did anyone tell you? Whatever they told you, they're wrong! I wasn't the only one it happened to either, so even if it did it wasn't a huge deal!
My preference would be someone hot. They don't have to be as hot as me because, well, that's a high bar to clear, you know?
Well, Nadeshiko, I'm looking for someone who is the full package, kind of like me. Looks, brains, and an interesting personality.
A-a partner, Nadeshiko? W-well, it's not like I've thought about that a whole lot. I just want what anyone wants. S-someone who... makes my heart r-race or... or whatever....
H-huh? Asking something like that out of the blue, Nadeshiko? I-I don't know! I just want someone who appreciates how awesome I am and... and yeah...
... I swear I only understand half of what she says.
All I got from that is you're angry for some reason and not knowing why you're angry is making meangry!
You're going to want a drink when you crash and burn against me! Might as well start now.
Ugh. Galarian tea. They were always like "you want cream and sugar?" No. I want tea...
Hey, don't hold back on our account. If you get woozy and have to drop out, that's... whatever.
On the contrary, I think a drink might be in order right about now...
I've heard some gourmets will pay out the nose for those lucky eggs. Still, seems like someone could do a lot better than offering you an egg for a tiring time.
Hmph, yeah. Gloria. People are wimps.
I don't smoke, but I do have a lighter in my bag. I also think I have some matches. All stuff for lighting candles... of which I have a few.
Oh, shoot! I can't let you leave before I get you to say "bottle of water!"

Ugh. Period dramas. I can't stand them. I mean, I just don't get them. Everyone is all stuffy and the marquess is not hot enough to be so crappy.{small}I mean, after what he pulled at the cotillion why is the lady still entertaining his advances?I mean, think back to the episode where they're at the derby and---
Hmph. Pokémon probably have trouble understanding Galarians too.
That about sums up my experience in Galar. They were weird about tea and wanted to fight over every little thing. I can... kinda respect all that.
Speaking of which, I was surprised just how much freely available fried food there was in Galar. It could give Unova a run for their money!
Careful, Gloria. Free food is only liable to make me stomp you even harder at this game.
There are some weird, seedy places in Unova... but, yeah, I guess this is literally not Unova. Seems like it is literally not anywhere...
Eh, pockets are whatever, Rosa. I used to moan about my clothes not having any, but I've gotten pretty good at packing my bag full of what I need. I've even got junk I don't need.
It's just a little chill. Don't get your panties in a bunch about it, Rosa. Toughen up!
I-I mean... it's not that cold... but getting all goose pimply is not a sexy look...
Whoa! Hey! You need to be careful where you're levitating that thing!
Hm. Well. I guess I can't take all the credit for the excellent cards I've been getting. I could say thanks...
I'm not thanking anybody until I clinch this whole thing!
Gee. Maybe I'm not feeling a whole lot of gratitude at this exact moment...
Why is she going on about that specifically?
She is... truly just yapping...
Say, ~trainer~, you're a Pokémon trainer, right? Have you ever heard of Kitakami? Are we really so small nobody knows about us?
Oh! Hey! This is actually really good! I don't know why they sell it in such stupidly big pieces, but who am I to complain? Seriously!

We're really big on mochi back home. We make all sorts with all kinds of ingredients throughout the year. Local legend goes that the guardians of our region were big mochi lovers, so that's how they came to be such a big deal.

Well, most days are pretty quiet. Just the odd tourist or lookie-loo to chase off. The most recent incident was actually a bit of a blast from the past, though, after the ogre reappeared after all those years...
Beats me. Might be because there's a big blue dome. Or maybe people who start academies just have some kind of weird fixation on fruit?
Just the same kind of stuff everyone else is looking for. Someone attractive who thinks I'm attractive. Someone who doesn't suck. Just, you know, normal stuff.
Not even. I'm a trainer. Besides, see the headband? Keeps this whole operation from flying in my face.
Well, you don't have to worry about mine, Leon. I don't intend on letting them out and having them run around. Who knows what other sort of crazy stuff there might be for them to get into...
Uh, you're welcome? Didn't realize this was all about you, narc.
Win or lose, I'm not about to give you the satisfaction of thinking you took me down easily. If you don't like it maybe you should bow out.
Oh? Is that what you think? Is that what you really think? Hahaha! Of course you would think that!
Wow, Leon. I can put up with slights against me, but it's a bit out of line to accuse my folks of raising a quitter.
Two claws up? Pfft, well, alright. Kinda dorky, but at least you have good taste.
Oh, this? I get my hair done at the same place everyone in Mossui Town does. I just wear it better than most, you know?
Uh, I'm still technically a student. I've been abroad for a while and I sorta... missed a lot of classes and stuff. I'm, like, really far behind...
Home. Everywhere else sucks. Blueberry Academy is fine, I guess, but that's kind of like my second home.
H-huh? Wh-which part? Th-these? N-n-n-n-no! You don't need to know about these! These are nothing! You really need to forget all about them!
W-well, yeah, d-duh. Only natural you'd be interested in that... of course...
My bag? I already put that away. Why are you asking about it now?
Right... and should I be worried about that just because you're a little creepy?
... Really? You don't sound all that confident in yourself.
... The fact that you felt like you had to tell me that says to me "this girl is terrified she's going to lose."
If you have to ask, then I haven't been giving you a hard enough time.
What's that supposed to mean? You'd better watch that mouth of yours before I cram it full of dirt!
Eh, it's not all that special just to be a trainer. If you want any kind of clout, you've got to be good.
Excuse me? Talking shit about my hair? Excuse me?! I hope whatever dumb skanks eat can be delivered intravenously because I will shut your stupid whore yap permanently.
I don't need your help! I don't need anyone's help! Just stand over there and wait for me to kick your butt!

Blueberry Academy is out in the middle of the ocean. Its main structure is an underwater dome that houses four vast biomes for studying Pokémon in their natural environments. It's very state of the art.
Aww, what? This? This style is fairly traditional in Kitakami! Women in my family have worn their hair like this for centuries. I do what I can to make it work for me.

Only one of the most beautiful regions you'll visit. From the dizzying heights of Oni Mountain to the winding waters of Fellhorn Gorge, there's plenty of natural beauty to behold. We've also got all the best snacks.
Uh... y-yeah, I'm good, Aoi. It's just... I sort of realized my underwear is kind of embarrassing today...
Y-yeah! W-w-well... I can't control my luck, okay? Just because I'll be in my underwear doesn't mean I'm not going to wreck you!
That's only natural, Aoi. If it's any comfort, just know I'm not this hot on accident. Skincare, exercise, makeup, I do it all.
I might be sunk because I don't now if I can take you serious enough to get mad when you're waving that weird stick around.
Blueberry Academy uniforms are mostly like this: streamlined with very little frills. There is an ascot for the dress shirts, but that's not really my style. I prefer the jumpsuit.
Hmph. Could be going better. I really shouldn't let myself get cornered like this.
Fair question. Kinda hard to give a straight answer to though. Sometimes you just get a feeling in your gut that you're supposed to. Eh, it's... I don't know if I can explain it...
And what? You got some kind of problem, blondie?!
Culture? From back home? There's a local legend that is pretty important to us. It's... uh... kind of a long story? Yeah! A long story... that I don't really have time to totally get into...
Please. I'm only the toughest trainer in all of Kitakami. Just the girl who brought down Terapagos and the Lousy Three. On top of all that... I'm just awesome.
Oh, rich commentary coming from you! Standing there and barely saying a thing! Pretending to be all cool! You're not fooling anybody!
... Oh? Did you say I'm pretty? D'aww! Don't butter me up just because you're getting to see more of my body. Well, I mean, unless you want to.
And you would be an expert on distinctive hairstyles, yeah?
Don't you think you're getting ahead of yourself, Leviathan? One slip-up a total loss does not make.
What? Am I just supposed to be happy about losing? It's losing! I'm supposed to be winning!
You can't be serious? It's me? Why does it have to be me? Huh? Someone else should go instead of me!
Well you'd better not be worried about it because if you're not going to be able to avoid it!
What's wrong with being competitive? If I'm too much for you to take, maybe you should go ahead and quit!
Hey! It's just one little loss! I'm not about to make a whole big deal out of it even if it is so incredibly stupid!
What? Am I supposed to over the moon to lose? I bet you had something to do with this.
Asking me about clothes while trying to get them off? Yeah, real class act.
Don't think you can underestimate me just because I'm still a student! You're gonna regret it if you don't take me seriously!
Kitakami? Well, other than Mossui Town and Kitakami Hall, all the land in the shadow of Mount Oni is untouched. We live with great reverence for the land and its history.
Well, yeah. Got a problem with that?
... Really? Aww, thanks! You're also quite pretty... for a robot. With a little effort, you could be a real knockout. Have you ever used makeup?

Ah... well... Leviathan, it's not all that hard to understand. It's still pretty intimate to be seen in your underwear... aaaand it's a bit more personal, almost. A person usually picks their underwear. It... says something... about them.
I would... but I'm feeling kind of... relieved... about it... this time.
I'm not beat yet, Leviathan. You don't know that I'm about to lose. I could just be about to blind you all with my brilliance...
Pokémon. I study Pokémon. Breeding, training, fighting, history. I just kind of work on whatever these days. Not really... focused on one thing over the other.
Yeah, it's not me who does the fighting. It's my Pokémon. I tell them what to do, and they mess up my opponent's Pokémon. Not that I think you understand what I'm saying... conceptually.

Well... Kitakami has a rich history. There's a local legend that is... very important to our culture. The story and characters are very famous and have made their way into every aspect of our lives... but...
Look, Nephenee, it's a complicated story and I have neither the time nor patience to explain it all to you, let alone someone who might understand it all.
You think so, Nephenee? You think you have me nailed? I'd love to hear psychoanalysis from someone who doesn't even know that word.
No, Sofia, it's the other way around. I work side by side with Pokémon every day. That's, like, part of my whole thing.

Ugh. It's like you don't even listen. Mossui Town is a small place and we've actually got the best festival around. Our Festival of Masks has food like mochi and candied apples as well as games like Ogre Oustin'.
If you're interested in it, why don't you invest some of your rich people money into it? Feels like if you really were interested, you'd put a lot more thought into your appearance.
You're damn, right, Sofia! I'm not bothered! Not me! Couldn't be me!
Careful, Sofia. Don't get a big head and go thinking you can just diss my hair.

I don't think they're all that different. You need a certain charisma to get people or Pokémon to follow your directions. With charisma, you can foster the trust you need to be listened to in a tough situation.
Summoner? No. I'm a Pokémon trainer. I carry them around with me in their Pokéballs until I need them or I find a place where I can just let them wander free.
Kitakami? Yeah, only the nicest little island around. We've got all the sights to see from our apple orchards, to the rice paddies, and the grand views from Mount Oni.
So I take pride in my appearance. Big deal. Not my fault that it looks like all the hairbrushes in your house are broken.
Don't get ahead of yourself, Sheena! I just got a little unlucky, that's all! I don't see why you should be getting a big head over it!
You grow your hair out, Sheena? Pfft. Yeah, right. You ought to get those split ends trimmed first.
My Pokémon? Well, I've got Mightyena and Ninetales, but my closest partner has always been my Sinistcha. They're all over Kitakami, so I always wanted to train one.
Winning is how I have fun. Why would I do something as idiotic as half-assing something or not bothering to care how it pans out?
My love life, Yae? I don't really have much of one. It's pretty quiet on that front.
Kitakami has had its troubles here and there. Our most famous legend is a story of a time where we were in danger, after all. A legend that I just so happen to be a part of now.
Yes, Yae! I saw it coming! What was I supposed to do about it? Not get a bunch of crummy cards?!
Me? Not stand out? N-no. No. Not really worried that... that'll be a problem.
The worst one? Probably that business with Terapagos. That was as real as it gets, and I don't think me and Sinistcha could have gotten through on our own...
Wwwwwhy, Darkness? Kind of a bizarre offer. You get off on being roughed up?
Yeah, Kitakami is its own island apart from pretty much everywhere else. We're not like a lot of places and we've got all our own stories because of it.
Oh, like you really know anything about it! We were lied to! And I had to fight, like really fight, to make things right again!
Well, Maria, it just comes naturally when you're as great as I am. Some people can't handle all those bragging rights.
This? This is just an everyday kind of look for me. I didn't want to send the wrong message by getting too dolled up, you know?
A bit of a long tale too, actually. It's an even longer story than it used to be, actually...
I think I'm angry at exactly the right people, Maria! Unlike you, I don't discriminate based on gender!
My hair? This style is all the rage in Kitakami. I'm sure you could pull it off too! It's got a lot of appeal!
You could say that. My Pokémon do all the actual fighting, but I'm right there directing them the whole way.
Getting better is the name of the game, Roll. Not that there's a whole lot better that someone like me could get.
What... makes you ask that, Roll? Do I really... seem like that type of girl?
If you're going to make a big deal out of it, Roll, then no. I'm not going to yell.
A shining endorsement, Roll. I just don't warm up to people immediately. I don't think that's any sort of crime.
What? Bombs? No! I think those are just my Poké Balls you're hearing! Who just carries a bunch of bombs around?
Breaking?! Me?! No one is better under pressure than me. I have no idea what you're talking about.
My... philosophy? Um... is "destroy chumps" a philosophy?
My Pokémon do the actual fighting. My part in the battle is to tell them what to do.
Well, Kaz, of course I could put in more effort than this. The real question is why I should bother for a bunch of clods like you?
Hey! Kaz! I've had just about enough of your attitude! Always so high and mighty! We all think you're just a pretentious poser!
What would I be looking for, Kaz? I just thought I'd push you all around a bit, that's all...
Common practice? Uh, yeah. Pokémon battles are huge. I'm not some kind of weirdo, if that's what you're saying.
Blueberry Academy? Yeah, it's pretty great. They've got all the most advanced technology when it comes to studying wild Pokémon and the Terastal phenomenon.
I get that, Y'shtola. Kitakami is pretty cool. The legend surrounding the ogre is a real big deal there. You know, I had a personal hand in bringing new details to light about that story.
Oh, you're gonna lecture me, Y'shtola? Sorry I don't run around with a stick all the way up my ass at all times! I'm not afraid to show people how I feel!
Don't get a big head about it, Y'shtola! This just... just a bad break for me, okay? I can still turn this around.
My type spread? You sure talk a lot like you know what you're saying for someone who isn't a Pokémon trainer.
Th-the Lousy Trio?! W-w-who cares who my favorite is o-or was? They all suck... obviously...
There's no way you're an actual Pokémon trainer, Bobobo. I've got too many serious battles under my belt to humor a fake trainer like you.
I didn't get the impression you were trying to get into my good graces, Bobobo. Honestly, I'd ignore you entirely if I could.
Uh, sure, I guess you could call Blueberry Academy a "duel academy." Kinda of reductive, but whatever. We do battling.
Look, Jura, if you're cool with just losing then go ahead and do that. My standards are a bit higher, though, so you'll just have to watch while I bowl the rest of you over.
It's not all luck, Meia. I thought I could play it smart and I might not end up... whatever. Seems like I might be totally cooked, anyway...
... ~Player~, can you remind Velvet that we're not playing prison rules here?
Yeah, I'm studying at Blueberry Academy. It keeps me pretty busy, so I don't make it out to the mainland of Unova near often enough.
It looks like... at a chocolate... factory? Uh... is this some kind of pick-up line? Are you hitting on me?
Haha! That family resemblance is really something, huh? So what did you think of Kiki's skills, hm? As his big sister, I taught him everything he knows!
As much as she can carry, Jean. Aside from my Pokéballs where I keep them, I also make sure to carry plenty of medicine to keep them healthy and food to keep them happy.
When it comes to a battle, I'm the one calling the shots. I take away my opponent's ability to fight at their best and then smash them with my overwhelming power.
You'd better watch it, Yusei! Maybe I'm just getting warmed up! Maybe you're only about to see me really get going!
Eh. Sometimes, I guess. I don't generally go in for organized competition. Most of my big battles are... spontaneous.
It's, like, whatever. I knew I might lose when I joined. It's not like I was opposed to... uh... any of this and... stuff...
Yeah. That's me. Passionate. I really go all in on the things I care about. Even if that makes me do some things that are embarrassing in hindsight...
Definitely not, crazy eyes. I would have remembered meeting someone like you...
Oh, I'll relax alright! Once I get my hands on whoever is responsible for making me lose this round!

I don't know what you're talking about! There wasn't an incident! Certainly not one anyone who values their life knows about! Besides, the answer to any question you might have is I don't remember any of it!
You got something to say, crazy eyes? You're avoiding eye contact even more than usual now.
I'm told it's a "Counterfeit Forme" Sinistcha. I hear the "Masterpiece Forme" ones are pretty rare. There's a lot of anecdotes about people looking for one and going mad.
How would I know if I had? I've seen some weird Pokémon in Kitakami... and some super annoying ones...
Well, I just meant it seems like you don't know about Pecharunt's friends, the Loyal Three....
Oh, come on! Can't you all just lose without involving me in it?
No! I'm not supposed to lose! You have to be joking!
Of all the unlucky--- I was perfectly happy without losing a hand, you know!
What? Again? But I already went! Can't you just be satisfied?!
Hey! Did you forget I already had a turn? What's the big idea?!
I have to take another turn? Seriously? But I already had one!
But I--- I already--- ugh, never mind! I'll just do it. Of course I'm not that lucky...
Why can't you just go down without a fight? Fine, fine, I'll get to it...
It's not even worth complaining about anymore. It's just bad luck.
Yeah, yeah, don't get too excited. This isn't as big a deal as you're thinking...
Ugh... you're probably going to hate me after this one...
Okay, I'll do it, but you're not allowed to complain later, okay?
... Maybe no one here knows about the Lousy Three. Maybe this won't be worth looking askance at...
... I think if I just play it cool nobody will notice how badly I screwed up this morning...
Ah! Oh no! This is bad! You're gonna see that I... I... w-well... uh... that is... uhm...
So I'll be... taking my panties off first. For personal reasons.
I'm sorry, but I need to get these panties off. Like, need-need.
Is it weird to take my panties off first? Because I'm about to do it. I just... have to...
